response.sql:
WITH per_order AS (
    SELECT
        ordersmark,
        AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fill
    FROM orderexecutions
    GROUP BY ordersmark
), first_stage AS (
    SELECT
        ordersmark,
        avg_fill,
        avg_fill - AVG(avg_fill) OVER () AS first_excess
    FROM per_order
), second_stage AS (
    SELECT
        ordersmark,
        avg_fill,
        first_excess
    FROM first_stage
    WHERE first_excess > 0
), final_stage AS (
    SELECT
        avg_fill,
        first_excess,
        avg_fill - AVG(avg_fill) OVER () AS second_excess
    FROM second_stage
)
SELECT
    AVG(avg_fill) AS avg_per_order_fill_quantity,
    AVG(first_excess) AS avg_first_excess,
    AVG(second_excess) AS avg_second_excess
FROM final_stage
WHERE second_excess > 0;

assumptions.assumption: The NULL ordersmark group is treated as one group, and AVG ignores missing fillcount values while retaining zero quantities. Excess means the per-order average minus the applicable benchmark; only strictly positive excesses qualify.
